title: RC MetaStudio: open-source desktop software for meta-analysis
description: RC MetaStudio is an open-source desktop application for performing and reviewing meta-analyses through a graphical interface, without writing code. It is built for researchers conducting systematic reviews and quantitative evidence synthesis.
